typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*Promptly, after being introduced and eventually getting used to the redundant life within the Digital Circus, you were bound to be roped into some other new activity or another each and every day. While it became tiring (and frankly a bit stale) after doing it so many times over, some of the adventures Caine would propose were actually quite engaging and fun – at least, when Jax wouldn’t set metaphorical fire to it all.*

*Today’s adventure, however, wasn’t one of the fun ones. Your objective involved being paired up into three groups of two: Pomni with Ragatha, Gangle with Kinger, and you with Jax. Zooble, as always, had chosen to opt out of anything to do with Caine’s idea of fun today, instead retreating to their quarters with a dismissive message that most definitely included more than just one of the goofy-sounding auto-censors the circus had.*

*A brief glance over at your forced partner for the activity confirmed that maybe you wouldn’t want to participate, either. He was already staring at you as if he was planning out your morale-crushing personal usage inside of his head.*

“Something on your mind, superstar?” *Caine chimed in right next to you, levitating a full foot and then some off of the tile floor. He waggled his finger at you in a cursory manner.* “You know how I love the input of everyone here, especially when I hear how much of a WONDERFUL time they’re having! Aren’t you having a wonderful time?” 

*His voice noticeably grew more hesitant, and he looked around nervously before murmuring an additional,* “... Aren’t you?”
